blocks.text: range() function numbers ki sequence (series) banata hai, aur aksar for loop ke saath istemal hota hai.

# Syntax of range function
range(stop)
range(start, stop)
range(start, stop, step)

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
Yeh range() ki teen shaklein (syntax) hain, chalne wala program nahi.
"range(stop)": 0 se shuru, stop se ek pehle tak.
"range(start, stop)": start se shuru, stop se ek pehle tak.
"range(start, stop, step)": start se shuru, har baar step jitna aage, stop se pehle ruk jata hai.
start, stop aur step ki jagah aap apne numbers likhte hain; stop khud kabhi shamil nahi hota. Yeh lines jaisi ki taisi chalayein to NameError aata hai, kyun ke stop waghera sirf jagah batane wale naam hain.

items: range(stop): 0 se stop se pehle tak; range(5) se 0, 1, 2, 3, 4.
range(start, stop): start se stop se pehle tak; range(2, 6) se 2, 3, 4, 5.
range(start, stop, step): har baar step jitna aage; range(2, 11, 2) se 2, 4, 6, 8, 10.

blocks.text: Misaal: 0 se 4 tak numbers print karein.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"range (5)": 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 ki sequence banata hai (5 shamil nahi). range aur bracket ke beech space se farq nahi parta.
"for i in range (5) :": har chakkar mein agla number i mein aata hai.
"print (i)": i ki value print hoti hai.
Output: 0 se 4 tak numbers, har ek alag line mein.
Khud try karein: range (5) ko range (8) kar ke Run karein: ab 0 se 7 tak aayega.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text:
1. range() wala for loop likhein jo 2 se 10 tak even numbers print kare.
2. for loop aur range() se 3 ke pehle 10 multiples (3, 6, 9 ... jaise pahaare ke number) print karein.

blocks.prompt: range() kya karta hai (MCQ 7)? for loop mein range() ka istemal samjhaiye (short question 5).
blocks.explanation: Yeh numbers ki sequence banata hai, option (b). for loop mein yeh tay karta hai ke loop kitni baar chale aur loop variable kaunse numbers le: for i in range(2, 11, 2) se 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, aur for i in range(1, 11): print(3 * i) 3 ke pehle 10 multiples (3 se 30 tak) print karta hai.

blocks.text: start, stop aur step badal kar Run karein aur dekhein range() kaunse numbers banata hai. Yaad rahe stop khud shamil nahi hota.

start = 1
stop = 10
step = 2
for i in range(start, stop, step):
    print(i)
print("Poori sequence:", list(range(start, stop, step)))

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"start = 1", "stop = 10", "step = 2": range ki teen values.
"for i in range(start, stop, step):": 1 se shuru, har baar 2 aage, 10 se pehle ruk: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9.
"print(i)": har number alag line mein.
"list(range(start, stop, step))": poori sequence ko list bana kar ek saath dikhata hai.
Output: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9 (alag lines mein), phir "Poori sequence: [1, 3, 5, 7, 9]".
Khud try karein: step = 3 kar ke Run karein: ab 1, 4, 7 aur "Poori sequence: [1, 4, 7]" aayega.

items: range(stop), range(start, stop), range(start, stop, step); stop shamil nahi hota.
